name: EarthSE — Earth-Silver MC
protocol: EarthSE paper v3 Earth-Silver fixed 250-item multiple-choice series; other EarthSE tiers and generation tasks are excluded.

explanation.en: The score is the fraction of Earth-Silver questions whose selected option matches the answer key.
explanation.zh: 分数是 Earth-Silver 中所选选项与答案一致的题目比例。

summary.en: EarthSE tests specialist Earth-science reasoning on expert-reviewed multiple-choice questions.
summary.zh: EarthSE 使用专家审核的选择题测试专业地球科学推理能力。

task_format.en: The model answers the fixed 250-item Earth-Silver four-choice set.
task_format.zh: 模型回答固定的 250 道 Earth-Silver 四选一题。
